---
name: Source suggestion
about: Suggest a paper, founder resource, or publishable observation.
labels: enhancement
---

## Source and date

Link to the public source, identify its author, and give its publication or event date.

## Who this helps

Describe the founder decision or reader question this source helps answer, and what it adds to the library.

## Suggested location

Name the relevant guide, research topic, conference collection, or field note.

## Evidence and permissions

Describe the source's limits and any restrictions on publication or reuse. Disclose your connection to the source or organization, if any.
